svg.title: Bug details: environment, severity, steps to reproduce and the version it was found in — SoftTrack web design mockup (#273)
svg.desc: A bug has a title, a description and a priority, the same as a task, so where it happens and how bad it is go into prose that nothing can filter. Tickets of type bug gain severity, environment, found in and fixed in, and three sections in the description, all of which can be filtered, grouped and charted.

from bug keeps the values and hides the fields.
